## Specification

### Component: Text shimmer

A soft band of light that sweeps across text, for loading and "thinking" labels. Pure CSS, no JavaScript
behaviour, Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
- `<span class="ui-text-shimmer" data-state="active|idle" style="--ui-text-shimmer-duration: 2000ms">Thinking…</span>`
- `asChild` puts the class and state on the child instead (e.g. an `<h3>`), merging className and style.

#### Props
- `active` (default `true`): runs the sweep; `false` sets `data-state="idle"` and shows plain text in the
  inherited colour.
- `duration` (ms): sets `--ui-text-shimmer-duration` inline; CSS default 2s.
- `asChild`: render the child element via `Slot`.
- Every other span attribute is forwarded (`ref`, `className`, `role`, `style`).

#### Visual rules
- Variables on `.ui-text-shimmer`: `--ui-text-shimmer-base: var(--ui-muted-foreground)`,
  `--ui-text-shimmer-highlight: var(--ui-foreground)`, `--ui-text-shimmer-band: 10%`; `color` = base.
- A `span` root is `display: inline-block` so the gradient spans the whole label.
- Inside `@supports (background-clip: text) or (-webkit-background-clip: text)`, active state:
  `linear-gradient(90deg, base calc(50% − band×2), highlight 50%, base calc(50% + band×2))`,
  `background-size: 250% 100%`, no repeat, `background-position: 100% 0`, `-webkit-background-clip: text`,
  `background-clip: text`, `-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent`.
- Without support: plain text in the base colour.
- `[data-state="idle"]`: `color: inherit` and no gradient.

#### Motion
- `@keyframes ui-text-shimmer { from { background-position: 100% 0 } to { background-position: 0% 0 } }` —
  the band travels from just left of the text to just right of it.
- `animation: ui-text-shimmer var(--ui-text-shimmer-duration, 2s) linear infinite`.
- RTL (`[dir="rtl"]` ancestor): `animation-direction: reverse`.
- Reduced motion: `animation: none; background-image: none; -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor` — static
  text in the base colour.

#### Accessibility
- The text stays real, selectable text and is read normally.
- It announces nothing; wrap it in `role="status"` when the label is the news.
- The resting colour (`--ui-muted-foreground`) meets 4.5:1 on the background; the band only brightens it.

#### Acceptance checks
- Active: computed `background-clip` is `text`, `animation-name` is `ui-text-shimmer`, and
  `background-position` changes over time.
- `active={false}`: `data-state="idle"`, no animation, text in the inherited colour.
- `duration={3200}` sets `--ui-text-shimmer-duration: 3200ms`.
- Reduced motion: `animation-name` is `none` and no background image.
- Works in light and dark; axe finds no serious violations.

### `ui/components/text-shimmer/text-shimmer.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';

export interface TextShimmerProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  /** Run the sweep. `false` shows plain text in the inherited colour (e.g. once the work is done). Default `true`. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** One sweep, in milliseconds. Default 2000. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Render the child element instead (e.g. a heading), keeping the shimmer. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/**
 * TextShimmer — a soft band of light that sweeps across text, for loading and "thinking" labels.
 * Pure CSS (gradient + background-clip: text), Server Component–safe. Reduced motion shows the
 * text static in the muted colour. It does not announce anything: wrap it in a `role="status"`
 * region when the label itself is the news.
 */
export const TextShimmer = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, TextShimmerProps>(function TextShimmer(
  { active = true, duration, asChild = false, className, style, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const shared = {
    className: cn('ui-text-shimmer', className),
    'data-state': active ? 'active' : 'idle',
    style: (duration !== undefined ? { '--ui-text-shimmer-duration': `${duration}ms`, ...style } : style) as CSSProperties,
    ...props,
  };
  if (asChild) {
    return (
      <Slot ref={ref as never} {...shared}>
        {children}
      </Slot>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span ref={ref} {...shared}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/text-shimmer.css`

```css
/* Text shimmer ------------------------------------------------------------
   <span class="ui-text-shimmer" data-state="active|idle">Thinking…</span>
   A band of --ui-text-shimmer-highlight sweeps over --ui-text-shimmer-base text,
   left to right (right to left in RTL), linear, one sweep per --ui-text-shimmer-duration.
   Gradient + background-clip: text; without support the text is plain base colour.
   [data-state="idle"]: plain text in the inherited colour.
   Reduced motion: static text in the base colour, no gradient.
   Tunable: --ui-text-shimmer-base | -highlight | -duration (2s) | -band (10%, half-width of the band)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-text-shimmer {
    --ui-text-shimmer-base: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-text-shimmer-highlight: var(--ui-foreground);
    --ui-text-shimmer-band: 10%;
    color: var(--ui-text-shimmer-base);
  }
  /* Inline spans need a box of their own for the gradient to span the whole label */
  .ui-text-shimmer:where(span) { display: inline-block; }

  @supports (background-clip: text) or (-webkit-background-clip: text) {
    .ui-text-shimmer[data-state="active"] {
      background-image: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--ui-text-shimmer-base) calc(50% - var(--ui-text-shimmer-band) * 2),
        var(--ui-text-shimmer-highlight) 50%,
        var(--ui-text-shimmer-base) calc(50% + var(--ui-text-shimmer-band) * 2)
      );
      background-size: 250% 100%;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-position: 100% 0;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      animation: ui-text-shimmer var(--ui-text-shimmer-duration, 2s) linear infinite;
    }
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-text-shimmer[data-state="active"] { animation-direction: reverse; }

  .ui-text-shimmer[data-state="idle"] { color: inherit; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-text-shimmer[data-state="active"] {
      animation: none;
      background-image: none;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
    }
  }
}

/* background-position 100% → 0% moves the band from just left of the text to just right of it */
@keyframes ui-text-shimmer {
  from { background-position: 100% 0; }
  to { background-position: 0% 0; }
}
```

## Usage

**Thinking label** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/text-shimmer/thinking.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { TextShimmer } from '@/ui/components/text-shimmer';

export default function TextShimmerThinking() {
  const [thinking, setThinking] = useState(true);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col items-start gap-4">
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
        <p className="mb-1 font-medium">Why did churn rise in October?</p>
        <p role="status">
          <TextShimmer active={thinking} className={thinking ? undefined : 'text-muted-foreground'}>
            {thinking ? 'Thinking through 3 quarters of billing data…' : 'Thought for 6 seconds'}
          </TextShimmer>
        </p>
      </div>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setThinking((t) => !t)}>
        {thinking ? 'Stop' : 'Ask again'}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
